name: Upcoming webinars list
purpose: Announces scheduled live webinars next to a short pitch for the series, falling back to an empty-state line when none are scheduled.
description: Two-column hairline block on the legacy "green" theme (stacked at 767): left half is a sticky intro (pill eyebrow, 1.75rem heading, grey line of copy); right half lists upcoming webinars as bordered rows (date pill + semibold title). With no webinars it renders the CMS empty state, a grey #ddd box reading "No items found.", which is what the only real page shows.
